mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level relative to its historical average compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a persistent trend signal without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong labor demand (high PAYEMS growth) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals a robust labor market that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 4.0% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high housing starts (HOUST above 1500k) and strong retail sales (RSAFS above 700k) indicate overbought market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 700.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO above 100) indicates robust supply chain activity and economic growth, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high housing starts (HOUST above 1500k) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%) signals a potential policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 1500 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL above 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%).
